request.prompt:

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Backing is now the sum of the patrons' settled figures over their SETTLED claims dated within the
90 days up to and including the sheet's today (each at its frozen figure), 0.00 with none.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.

agent.result_text:
A person's backing is now the sum of their patrons' settled figures over SETTLED claims dated in the last 90 days, and 0.00 when there are none. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

Backing was already worked out in the browser, so this was a front-end change only. No stored data, server code or audit records changed.

- **`src/main/frontend/features/claims/claims.ts`**: a new `recentSettledCents(claims, person, today)` adds up a person's SETTLED claims dated from today minus 89 days through today, each at the figure frozen when it was settled. That window is today plus the 89 days before it, the same way the existing 30-day "active" check counts. A claim dated after the sheet's today is left out.
- **`src/main/frontend/features/patrons/patrons.slot.tsx`**: backing now uses that helper instead of adding up the patrons' due-totals. I removed the rate, floor, cap and late-charge lookups it no longer needs.

A claim settled when its grade had no rate has no frozen figure, so it adds 0.00 to backing.
